correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier eigenvalues \(0,-4\kappa,-2\kappa\pm2i\) yield all four circulant resolvent coefficients. Two offdiagonals are strictly positive; the last has the sign of a single-positive-root quadratic. The theta update subtracts only a diagonal multiple, and the resolvent diagonal strictly decreases from 1 to 1/4, proving every timestep branch. The Crank–Nicolson critical comparison reduces to \(\kappa^2+2\kappa-1\ge0\). The embedded verifier passed symbolic identities and 320 direct rational matrix inversions; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural positivity phase diagram on the smallest even grid with a nontrivial centered convective derivative quantifies when diffusion rescues the pure-advection obstruction. In particular the exact second-order Crank–Nicolson frontier \(d/a=\sqrt2-1\) lies strictly inside the non-Metzler centered spatial regime \(d/a<1\); its isolated boundary step and bounded positivity window are significant qualitative effects. No high-accuracy or arbitrary-grid conclusion is claimed.
